title: carum involucratum
intro: Carum involucratum, commonly known as wild caraway, is a plant species in the carrot family, characterized by its small, white flowers and fern-like leaves. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include its ability to aid digestion, alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of wild caraway include its use as a natural anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant, making it a popular remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Carum involucratum include carvone, limonene, and beta-pinene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
